global_limits: Do not promote canonical examples or mark records REVIEWED.
EDAM/ECO terms omitted from newly proposed method objects unless independently verified; schema MethodTypeEnum already captures computational versus experimental status.
CASTp, M-CSA and MetalPDB web methods lack a verified runnable local recipe: keep explicit limitations, do not fabricate a CLI or repurpose a documentation URL as a command.
Article access does not establish data-redistribution rights. Keep existing source terms and use citations/paraphrase only.
Legacy causal graphs are not recertified by this proposal; narrow edge findings are in saved native reviews.
